_about: Are level-ups what Outgrow keeps planning in a finished city? The user's test (23 Oct): stop the game's own level-ups instead of Outgrow's switch. In their city '123' (read-only: loaded, never saved) every garden is first planned again with this build (Redo; polishIdle: what outgrowing the whole city costs). Then, from that state, Outgrow running with level-ups planned (as it ships) in every stretch: 45 s paused (baseline), 45 s with the game's building upkeep stopped (BuildingUpkeepSystem: nothing levels up), 45 s with it running, 45 s stopped again. Read plansWritten, putInLine, frames over 50 / 100 ms and collections of each.
